arguments.command:
python -c "
import re
with open('unpacked/word/document.xml', 'r') as f:
    xml = f.read()
# Pretty print paragraphs with their styles
paras = re.findall(r'<w:p\b.*?</w:p>', xml, re.DOTALL)
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    style = re.search(r'<w:pStyle w:val=\"([^\"]+)\"', p)
    text = ''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>', p))
    print(f'--- Para {i} ---')
    print(f'  Style: {style.group(1) if style else \"(none)\"}')
    print(f'  Text: {text[:80]}')
"

cd unpacked && python - <<'EOF'
import re
# Add settings content type
with open('[Content_Types].xml') as f:
    ct = f.read()
if 'settings.xml' not in ct:
    ct = ct.replace(
        '<Override PartName="/word/document.xml"',
        '<Override PartName="/word/settings.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.settings+xml"/>\n  <Override PartName="/word/document.xml"',
        1
    )
with open('[Content_Types].xml', 'w') as f:
    f.write(ct)

# Add settings relationship
with open('word/_rels/document.xml.rels') as f:
    rels = f.read()
if 'relationships/settings' not in rels:
    rels = rels.replace(
        '</Relationships>',
        '  <Relationship Id="rId3" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/settings" Target="settings.xml"/>\n</Relationships>',
        1
    )
with open('word/_rels/document.xml.rels', 'w') as f:
    f.write(rels)
print('done')
EOF
